items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Handy was right in with us. He was in with the whole thing.

ctx.x: I just heard it. He had that Four Brothers thing ready in about 20 minutes, as I say. We began work then. George Handy was right in with us. He was in with the whole thing. He just couldn’t believe it. He says, “This is incredible.” They both were saying things like, “I never saw anything like this.” It was a new thing. It was the ideas of Eddie Jefferson and Eddie Jefferson taken into the orchestral form.
